description.value:
Prerequisites: Blood of the Dragon class feature

After suffering physical trauma, the dragon blood within you begins to coagulate, stanching blood loss and hardening your defenses for a brief period. When taking lethal damage to your hit points, you reduce all bleed damage on you by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier. Additionally, you receive a circumstance bonus to your Fortitude saves for the same amount, lasting for 1 round. You must have at least 1 dragon blood point remaining for this talent to activate.
